Package neqsim.process.util.optimizer

Class ProcessModelOperatingEnvelopeStudy.OperatingRegionTransition

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.util.optimizer.ProcessModelOperatingEnvelopeStudy.OperatingRegionTransition
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Enclosing class:
ProcessModelOperatingEnvelopeStudy
public static final class ProcessModelOperatingEnvelopeStudy.OperatingRegionTransition extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable sampled operating-region change across one adjacent grid edge.

This diagnostic preserves the exact endpoint outcomes and leading-constraint identities. It does not locate a continuous boundary. In particular, an edge traversing a discrete action records two evaluated line-ups and never authorizes interpolation between them.

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim Development Team
